name: kelkoo_group-mcp
description: Kelkoo Group (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_kelkoo_group_jwt.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KELKOO_GROUP_JWT
platform_mcp_kelkoo_group_jwt.description: Merchant Statistics API token (Kelkoo Merchant Center > API Credentials > Create new token; the JWT is shown once), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It reaches every campaign managed by the login.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account resource; the probe is GET /my-campaigns (the campaigns the token's login manages).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /my-campaigns: [{campaignId, campaignName, websiteUrl, country}] for every campaign (one merchant site per country) the token's login manages. Kelkoo campaigns carry no status or budget in this API; `account_id`, `status`, `page` and `limit` are not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /category/{campaign_id}?startDate&endDate (both included, up to two years back): clicks and cost per day, category and device for one campaign; campaign_id is REQUIRED. sales and order_value are filled only with Kelkoo Sales Tracking. Yesterday's data may still be compiling. `account_id` is not sent.
